rescueProtocol.seizureDescription: Usually starts with déjà vu and a rising feeling in my stomach. I may stare, stop responding, and smack my lips or fiddle with my hands for about a minute. Afterwards I am confused and very tired.
rescueProtocol.rescueMedicationInstructions: If a seizure lasts more than 5 minutes, or I have 3 in an hour: give one spray of midazolam (5 mg) into one nostril. It is in the front pocket of my bag.
rescueProtocol.whenToCall911: Call emergency services if a seizure lasts longer than 5 minutes, if seizures happen back to back without recovery in between, if I am injured, if I have trouble breathing, or if it happens in water.
rescueProtocol.howToHelp: Stay calm and stay with me. Time the seizure. Move sharp or hard things away. Do not hold me down. Do not put anything in my mouth. If I fall, cushion my head and turn me on my side when the jerking stops. Speak calmly — I may be confused for a while afterwards.
